submission.causalMechanism: The conclusion correction flow in loop.py appends a user message with the "Harness conclusion gate rejected this candidate conclusion" text, then calls bind_run_state() to persist the run. The loop's bind_run_state() closure (line 680) passes `observations` and `seen_tool_call_ids` state accumulated during the run. When the conclusion correction handler force-appends a user "correction" message into the message list, the subsequent bind_run_state() at line 2188 passes the growing observations/seen_tool_call_ids accumulated in the loop (possibly non-empty from prior turns), which SQLiteHarnessAgentBridge.bind_run_state() rejects at line 120-124 because it checks `if observations or seen_tool_call_ids:` and raises ToolBridgeError. The loop catches this at 2189-2193 and stops with RUNTIME_UNKNOWN carrying the error text.
submission.hypothesis: When a no-Tool Agent Run (bound to SQLiteHarnessAgentBridge) enters conclusion correction/control handling, the loop calls bind_run_state() with observations and seen_tool_call_ids that include the conclusion correction (rejection/user feedback) messages. The SQLiteHarnessAgentBridge.bind_run_state() at sqlite_agent_bridge.py:120 raises ToolBridgeError because `observations or seen_tool_call_ids` is truthy — meaning either accumulated tool observations or seen tool call identities from the conclusion correction control messages are being passed to the bridge, violating the no-Tool capability boundary. The loop.py conclusion correction path at lines 2187-2193 catches ToolBridgeError and stops with RUNTIME_UNKNOWN containing the no-Tool error message.
submission.nextFalsifier: Verify whether the loop's bind_run_state() closure actually passes non-empty observations/seen_tool_call_ids in the conclusion correction path, or whether the trigger is from the correction message content itself being interpreted as observations. Also check whether this only occurs after tool-using turns mixed with prediction (and check the exact condition that causes the bridge invariant breach in the conclusion_corrections retry path versus the normal bind path).
